title: Switching parties and not sharing items, gold, weapons, etc

posts.author: sushibyte
posts.body: I have 20 characters in my game, making up 5 different parties. When you switch worlds, you switch parties and I don't want to share gold, weapons, etc. Would I need a plugin to achieve this or is there another way?

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body: Theoretically, one can achieve that using only pure eventing, but realistically, you should use a plugin. I think there are already a handful out there because this question is frequently asked.

posts.author: sushibyte
posts.body: there are certainly party switching plugins but I haven't found any that ables each party to have their own inventories

posts.body:
Unless I've missed something, that code stores the data per-session, rather than per-playthrough: it is only initialised on boot, not on new game, and is not stored in save files. This means:
Recalling an inventory saved during the current session for a different playthrough is possible.
Attempting to load any inventory saved in a different session will fail.

your problem is that different programmers use the term "Party Manager" differently, making it almost impossible to search for a specific variant.
Most party manager plugins are for managing the actors inside a single party (like yanfly's).
What you want is a party manager in Tsukihime's style for managing multiple parties (including different members and different inventories).
Officially Tsukihime's Party Manager on himeworks.com is only for MV, but I recently heard that it also works in MZ (might or might not need FOSSIL)
